newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Some 200,000 political prisoners in N.Korea - Seoul.
newsitem.headline: Some 200,000 political prisoners in N.Korea - Seoul.

text.p: An estimated 200,000 political prisoners are being held in 10 detention camps across North Korea, a report from the South Korean unification ministry said on Sunday.

Prisoners in the North included anti-government activists, those who attempted to escape the Stalinist state and some abducted South Koreans, a ministry official quoted the report submitted to the National Assembly as saying.
Two former secretaries of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea and a former North Korean navy commander were also among those being held, the report said.
The official said the information was based on reports from Amnesty International and testimony by North Korean defectors.
South Korea has claimed that about 450 South Koreans have been abducted and detained in North Korea.
The two Koreas have remained technically at war since their 1950-53 conflict ended with only an armistice treaty.
